        cand=[]
        for dr in range(-H,H+1):
            for dc in range(-W,W+1):
                pos={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in p}
                if any(not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W) for r,c in pos): continue
                if pos&occ: continue
                if not any((r+1,c) in occ or (r-1,c) in occ or (r,c+1) in occ or (r,c-1) in occ for r,c in pos): continue
                cand.append((abs(dr)+abs(dc),pos))
        cand.sort(); return cand
    others=sorted(comps,key=lambda o:min(abs(r-ar)+abs(c-ac) for ar,ac in occ for r,c in o[0]))
    for p,c0 in others:
        cand=best_for(p,{c0},{(r,c):None},H,W)
        _,pos=cand[0]
        occ|=pos
        for r,c in pos: res[r][c]=c0
    # crop to content
    rows=[r for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if res[r][c]!=bg]
    cols_=[c for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if res[r][c]!=bg]
    if not rows: return [[bg]]
    r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows); c0_,c1_=min(cols_),max(cols_)
    return [row[c0_:c1_+1] for row in res[r0:r1+1]]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def comps_of(I):
    I=np.array(I); bg=int(Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0])

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def comps_of(I):
    I=np.array(I); bg=int(Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0])
    lab,n=ndimage.label(I!=bg,structure=np.ones((3,3),int))
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pts=[tuple(p) for p in np.argwhere(lab==i).tolist()]
        cols=[int(I[r,c]) for r,c in pts]
        c0=int(Counter(cols).most_common(1)[0][0])
        mset=frozenset((r,c,int(I[r,c])) for r,c in pts if int(I[r,c])!=c0)
        out.append({'cells':pts,'c0':c0,'minority':mset})
    return bg,out

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
# Plan: verify f(demo_in)==demo_out for every demo, then apply to test input.
# Rule candidates:
#  R1: anchor(s) stay; each other object slides diagonally down-left (dr=+1,dc=-1) one step at a time
#     while its next position fits inside grid AND does not overlap any occupied/placed cell;
#     stop when next step would overlap or exit. Place onto canvas; crop to content bbox.
def solve(I,O=None):
    Ti=np.asarray(I); H,W=Ti.shape
    cs=comps_of(Ti)
    bgc=Counter(Ti.ravel().tolist()).most_common(1)[0][0] if False else None
    # background: most common value overall
    cnt=Counter(Ti.ravel().tolist()); bgc=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    objs=[]
    for p in cs:
        obj={}
        for r,c in p: obj[(r,c)]=int(Ti[r,c])
        objs.append(obj)
    g=[[bgc]*W for _ in range(H)]; occupied=set()
    # order objects by distance to nearest edge? anchor = object touching left/top edge? 
    # anchor def: object whose bbox touches grid border (row0 or col0)
    anchors=[i for i,o in enumerate(objs) if min(r for r,c in o)>=0 and min(c for r,c in o)==0]
    # actually anchor = touching border
    anchors=[i for i,o in enumerate(objs) if (min(r for r,c in o)==0) or (min(c for r,c in o)==0)]
    # also single-color check
    for i in anchors:
        for r,c,v in o.items(): g[r][c]=v; occupied.add((r,c))
    others=sorted([i for i in range(len(objs)) if i not in anchors],key=lambda i:min((r+c) for r,c in objs[i]))
    for i in others:
        cur=dict(objs[i]); dr,dc=0,0
        step=0
        while True:

    occ=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for cc,cs_ in compsM:
        for p in cs_: occ[p[0]][p[1]]=cc
    # place objects onto output grid in order of topmost
    objs=sorted(compsM, key=lambda t:min(p[0] for p in t[1]))
    placed={}; res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for cc,cells in objs:
        d=0
        while True:

        # compute candidate shifts

        best=None
        for dr,dc in cand:
            sh=set()
            ok=True
            for p in cells:

                if np_[0]<0 or np_[1]<0 or np_[0]>=H or np_[1]>=W: ok=False;break
                if (np_) in placed: ok=False;break

    keep=[j for j in range(W) if any(res[i][j]!=bg for i in range(H))]
